identitySignals: BlueSprig's Trumpet Behavioral Health page lists both 'The Behavior Center' and 'Therapeutic Pathways' (Kendall Centers) as affiliated ABA therapy brands, matching the agenda's combined name 'The Behavior Center, Therapeutic Pathways'
Therapeutic Pathways operates a Modesto, CA center (1115 14th St), matching the agenda location of Modesto, CA
Both brands provide autism and behavior therapy, consistent with a special education nonpublic agency contract
research.notes: Medium confidence only. The agenda names a combined 'The Behavior Center, Therapeutic Pathways' with Modesto, CA; no registry (CA Secretary of State, SAM.gov) record was confirmed, so the exact contracting legal entity is unverified and may differ from the BlueSprig parent. The Behavior Center has no listed Modesto location; Therapeutic Pathways does. therapeuticpathways.com is a parked domain, so no own-website contact details were used. Contact fields left null to avoid attributing a single center's details to the vendor.

profile.summary: The Behavior Center and Therapeutic Pathways (Kendall Centers) are affiliated brands under BlueSprig, a provider of Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy for children with autism. They offer center-based, home-based and school-based behavioral services.
